caption: : Avg. performance across 11 datasets (y-axis) consistently improves as the number of training examples increases (x-axis). Max is 29k examples, the full size of our dataset.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the average performance and the number of training datasets. The x-axis is labeled “# of training dataset (k)” with a linear scale ranging from 5 to 30, in increments of 5. The y-axis is labeled “Average Performance” with a linear scale ranging from 47 to 56, in increments of 1. A single black solid line is present, starting at coordinates (5, 47.5) and ending at (30, 55). Between these points, the line steadily increases; at x = 10, the y-value is approximately 50, and at x = 20, the y-value is approximately 52.5.
